name: ci-cd-pipeline-engineering
purpose: Design, author, and optimize secure CI/CD pipelines, multi-stage container builds, caching strategies, and automated release workflows.
whenToUse: Setting up GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or local build pipelines for automated testing
Authoring minimal, rootless, multi-stage Dockerfiles and container configurations
Optimizing build and test execution speed with package manager caching and parallel jobs
Configuring automated semantic releases, changelog generation, and tag publication
Implementing deployment rollback triggers and health check verification scripts
prerequisites: Read-only access to repository root, build manifests, test scripts, and workflow directories
Familiarity with target CI platform syntax (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Makefile)

inputs.name: ciPlatform
inputs.description: Target automation platform: github-actions, gitlab-ci, or local-docker (default: github-actions)

inputs.name: targetEnvironments
inputs.description: Target runtime environments: node, python, rust, go, or multi-stage container

inputs.name: cachingEnabled
inputs.description: Whether to configure dependency and build artifact caching (default: true)

procedure.title: Pipeline Requirements & Lifecycle Gate Mapping
procedure.action: Map framework verification commands and test runners into deterministic CI stages: lint, typecheck, test, build, and security audit.

procedure.title: Dependency Caching & Performance Optimization
procedure.action: Configure platform-specific caching layers (npm cache, pip wheels, cargo target) to minimize pipeline duration and network transfers.

procedure.title: Multi-Stage Rootless Dockerfile Construction
procedure.action: Write optimized container manifests: separate build stages from lean runtime images, drop root privileges to an unprivileged user, and add explicit HEALTHCHECK instructions.

procedure.title: Security & Secret Least-Privilege Hardening
procedure.action: Enforce minimum token permissions (GITHUB_TOKEN permissions: read-all), pin GitHub Action versions to full commit SHAs, and prevent secrets exposure in build logs.

procedure.title: Automated Release & Health Check Scripting
procedure.action: Author semantic release workflows with automated changelog extraction, npm/container publication, and post-deployment canary health checks.

expectedOutputs: Fully configured CI workflow YAML files (.github/workflows/ci.yml, release.yml)
Pipeline execution summary documenting build stages and estimated run times

potentialFailures: Cache invalidation issues causing stale dependencies in CI
Flaky test runs in virtualized CI environments
Docker permission errors when switching to unprivileged users
failureAndRecovery.recoveryStrategy: Use explicit lockfile hash keys for cache busting. Add retries to network-dependent steps, and verify user permissions on mounted volumes before container startup.

verificationCriteria: All CI workflow files pass schema validation for the target platform
Docker images build without warnings and run as an unprivileged user
Pipeline jobs fail fast with exit code non-zero upon any test or lint error
